description: Complete inventory of 144 World Bank indicators for Riksdagsmonitor political intelligence. This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — both AI agents (via view tool) and TypeScript modules load from this file.
source: World Bank Open Data API (api.worldbank.org/v2) + worldbank-mcp@1.0.1

notes.wgiGovernance: WGI indicators (CC.EST, RQ.EST, PV.EST, GE.EST, RL.EST, VA.EST) require source=75 in REST API calls. The WorldBankClient handles this automatically.
notes.annualData: All indicators are annual time-series. Most have 20+ years of Sweden data.
notes.mcpVsRest: 19 indicators available via MCP tools (get-economic-data, get-social-data, get-education-data, get-health-data). Remaining 125 available via REST API client.
notes.aiAgentUsage: AI agents should `view analysis/worldbank/indicators-inventory.json` to discover indicators. Use MCP tools (get-economic-data, get-social-data, etc.) for indicators with mcpTool field. The TypeScript module world-bank-context.ts loads from this file automatically.

scope: Non-economic residue ONLY. World Bank is NEVER used for economic context in Riksdagsmonitor. All macro / fiscal / monetary / external-sector / trade / commodity / FX / interest-rate / labour-market context comes from IMF (analysis/imf/indicators-inventory.json). World Bank covers: WGI governance (source=75), environment, social / health / education participation, demographics, defence historicals, agriculture, innovation, crime / justice.
